Example dashboards

Source: R/dashconfig.R
rvisDashboardExample.Rd

Lists the example dashboard configurations that come with rvis, or returns the path of one of them.

Usage

rvisDashboardExample(name = NULL)

Arguments

name

Name of an example (file name without extension). If NULL, the examples are listed.

Value

A data frame of the examples (name, group, title and file) if name is NULL, otherwise the path of the example file.

Examples

rvisDashboardExample()
